title: Count Indices With Opposite Parity
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, calculate the score for each index i as the count of indices j where i < j < n and nums[i] and nums[j] have different parities.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, calculate the score for each index i as the count of indices j where i < j < n and nums[i] and nums[j] have different parities. Return an array answer of length n, with answer[i] representing the score of index i.
constraints: For every index i, inspect indices strictly to its right.
Count values whose parity differs from nums[i].
hints: Count all even and odd values first.
Before answering an index, remove its value from the remaining inventory.
Read the bucket for the opposite parity.
Removing values left to right leaves exactly the strict suffix.
editorial: Removing values left to right leaves exactly the strict suffix.

tests.explanation: One has two even values to its right; two has one odd; three has one even; four has none.
No value has an opposite-parity value to its right.
